name: Coiled tubing and well intervention
principle: A continuous steel pipe (normally 1 to 3.25 inch) on a reel is pushed into live wells for cleanouts, chemical placement, milling, logging and drilling. It trips faster than jointed pipe and acts as a nearly closed system, but cannot trip jointed pipe and needs a larger offshore footprint than wireline.

process_steps.name: Rig up coiled-tubing unit and well control stack
Run the coil and circulate or mill
